protocol.evaluation_set: fixed in-domain set: all 300 sorted Monet + first 300 sorted photos (model trained on these domains; not held-out)
protocol.kid: unbiased MMD^2, polynomial kernel (x.y/d + 1)^3, d=2048, gamma=1/d, coef0=1, degree=3; 100 random subsets of 100 (no replacement) from 300 vs 300, RandomState(42); also full-sample 300 vs 300
protocol.precision_recall: Kynkaanniemi 2019 k-NN manifolds, k=3, Euclidean on 2048-d Inception features
protocol.cycle_L1: mean |x - G_back(G_fwd(x))| on [0,1] pixel scale, raw tensors before JPEG
protocol.lpips: lpips 0.1.4, net=alex (v0.1), inputs in [-1,1], spatial mean
protocol.content_cosine: cos(Inception(input file), Inception(JPEG translation)), matched by sorted filename
protocol.inception: torchvision inception_v3 IMAGENET1K_V1, transform_input=False, fc=Identity, Resize299/CenterCrop299/ImageNet norm (course evaluator definition)
